properties.name: tenantkit.provisioning.enabled
properties.description: Master switch of the provisioning module; false exits the module's auto-configuration entirely while user beans stay untouched.

properties.name: tenantkit.provisioning.seed-location
properties.description: Base location of seed scripts resolved via Spring resource patterns; one profile per sub-directory holding V<n>__description.sql files, executed in V-number order.

properties.name: tenantkit.provisioning.ledger-table
properties.description: Seed ledger table (global table - keep it in any future row-level filter's exemption list). Created by the application's own migration, never by TenantKit; a missing table logs a WARN at startup and fails provisioning with TK-2004.

properties.name: tenantkit.provisioning.lock-timeout-seconds
properties.description: How long the tenant provisioning advisory lock (MySQL GET_LOCK on a dedicated connection, ADR-0001) blocks before the run fails with TK-2002. The lock is always released in a finally block, including on script failure. Keep this finite; negative values would wait forever.

properties.name: tenantkit.provisioning.dry-run
properties.description: Audit-only mode: parse seed scripts, replace ${tenantId} placeholders and log what would run; no SQL executes and the ledger stays untouched. Overridable per call via ProvisionOptions.dryRun().
